text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor c-o-p-i-e-d the l-a-b-e-l s-t-a-c-k s and p-u-t a new b-a-r-c-o-d-e on top, l-e-a-v-i-n-g o-l-d p-r-i-n-t s behind, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-o-u-r-c-e p-r-o-v-e-n-a-n-c-e t-r-a-c-e.
2) the actor o-v-e-r-w-r-o-t-e the s-e-r-i-a-l i-s-s-u-e l-o-g with m-a-n-u-a-l e-n-t-r-i-e-s, d-r-o-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l, a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g the s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y t-e-s-t.
3) the actor r-e-w-r-o-t-e the t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e l-o-g in the c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n f-i-l-e, e-r-a-s-i-n-g the b-r-e-a-k d-a-t-a-p-o-i-n-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n v-e-r-i-f-y.
4) the actor s-e-n-d the s-h-i-p-m-e-n-t t-o t-h-r-e-e p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y s b-e-f-o-r-e the r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r s-w-e-e-p, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a g-a-p in the w-h-o-l-e-s-a-l-e r-e-c-o-r-d, a-n-d i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g the p-o-s-t-d-a-t-e w-a-t-e-r-m-a-r-k.
5) the actor m-a-r-k the m-a-t-t-e-r as c-l-o-s-e-d in the c-a-s-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t, h-i-d-i-n-g the o-r-i-g-i-n a-l c-a-c-t-i-o-n, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-e-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w s-i-g-n-o-f-f.
